explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem is an extensionality lemma for morphisms out of the library's own `geckGroupScheme`. Such morphisms are determined by their composites with the library's root subgroups (`geckRootSubgroup`) and weight torus (`geckWeightTorus`). The proof reduces the statement to `TauCeti.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.kostantToralGroupScheme_hom_ext`, another lemma of the same library. The only Mathlib facts it uses are generic category-theory glue (`cancel_epi`, `eqToHom`, `Category.assoc`). Mathlib has no Chevalley/Kostant group-scheme construction built from root data, so the mathematical content belongs entirely to the library's definitions. Because of that, I did not need to search Mathlib further.
